method: Deterministic float64 CPU mathematics audit. Hand port of the recorded v32 formula, not WGSL execution/readback, volume sampling, real GPU integration, image quality or performance evidence. Candidate shader is reconstructed in memory from the immutable patch and its verified parent, not claimed to be the current production source. All patch context and Git blob hashes must match. Gauss-Legendre integrates axisymmetric phase with solid-angle factor 1/2; positivity also has an analytic convex-mixture proof. Homogeneous recurrence uses constant density/source, clipped final segments, no early cutoff, no jitter and no camera micro erosion. The negative control deliberately replaces fixed120m by march segment length.

positivity.analytic: For rho>=0, ice in[0,1], a in[.55,.85]; HG(g) positive for |g|<1. Convex mixture therefore positive and normalized for every outgoing angle, not only quadrature samples. The denominator clamps do not activate: minima are (1-.68)^2=.1024 and (1-.25)^2=.5625, both>.04.

endpoints.interpretation: Analytic identity; reported rounding uses float64 only and does not prove bit identity on the GPU.

negativeControl.method: Incorrect phase uses the current step length in tauLocal instead of .12km; density/source are homogeneous.
